subject: world_language
concept: Naming family member words (mom, dad, sibling) in the target language
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student points to family photos/illustrations and names each family role in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a family-role word to the correct family tree position
exercise.abstract: Student names a described family member in the target language

misconception_flags: confuses gendered family terms where the target language marks them

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
